Google TPU 8tx AI System Launches With Isolated-Data Promise but No Way to Verify It

Google TPU 8tx, a confidential-computing AI system unveiled Monday, promises that sensitive data and model weights stay protected and isolated in use, but Google's launch post names no attestation method, threat model or independent audit. The article covers AMD EPYC host risks, customer data center
